name: 实现规范与单一路径

question.instructions: Evaluate Implementation Hygiene: single implementation path for core capabilities, propagate unhandleable exceptions cleanly without useless try/catch wrappers, never swallow exceptions in catch blocks with only a log/print statement, and use standardized logging.

criteria.passed: Single implementation path for core domain logic; exceptions propagate cleanly when unhandleable or retain original cause with explicit recovery/failure handling; no useless try/catch or log-only swallowed catch blocks.
criteria.violated: Dual-track parser or converter introduced, redundant try/catch that merely catches and rethrows or swallows exceptions with only a log/null return, or broken logging standards.

why: 核心正交架构红线：同一核心领域能力全工程保持唯一实现路径；不加无用 try/catch，严禁 catch 后仅打日志就把异常吃掉掩盖第一现场。
